# Dedon Tech

> Dedon Tech is an independent technology publication written by Amedu Danjuma, offering in-depth analysis of Nigerian fintech, energy, and AI alongside practical software, legal tech, and insurance guides for readers in Nigeria, the US, the UK, and Canada.

## Core Pages & Policies
- [Home](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/): Latest analyses, regulatory breakdowns, and technology comparisons.
- [About Dedon Tech](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/p/about.html): Background on the publication, author credentials, and coverage scope.
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/p/editorial-policy.html): Research methodology, independence disclosures, and correction standards.
- [Site Map](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/p/site-map.html): Full index of published articles and guides.
- [Contact](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/p/contact.html): Editorial inquiries, corrections, and contact details.

## Primary Coverage Areas
- [Fintech](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/Fintech): Nigerian mobile money, CBN regulations, OPay, MTN MoMo, open banking, real-time payments, and automated wealth tools.
- [Energy & Infrastructure](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/Energy): Nigerian refining, pipelines, solar energy initiatives, and telecom/fibre infrastructure analysis.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/Artificial%20Intelligence): AI policy, governance, safety, African language models, and practical enterprise AI workflows.
- [AI in Legal Tech](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/AI%20in%20Legal%20Tech): Legal case management software, e-discovery, agentic workflows, and HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance for US law firms.
- [InsurTech](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/InsurTech): Usage-based telematics car insurance, cyber insurance policies, and claims automation for UK, US, and Canadian policyholders.
- [B2B SaaS & Web Development](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/B2B%20SaaS): Software pricing comparisons, cybersecurity patches, PHP development, and technical SEO guides.

## Regional Guides
- [US Guides](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/US%20Guide): Legal tech, cyber insurance, and software comparisons tailored to US businesses and professionals.
- [UK Guides](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/UK%20Guide): UK telematics insurance, digital banking, and regulatory comparisons.
- [Canada Guides](https://www.dedontech.com.ng/search/label/Canada%20Guide): Canadian payment rails, fintech automation, and financial software guides.
